{"sql":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.acct) FROM aster_account a JOIN aster_bridge b ON b.acct = a.acct JOIN aster_orders o ON o.buyer = b.buyer JOIN aster_line l ON l.oid = o.oid WHERE a.region = 'West' AND o.state = 'ok0' AND l.sku = 'PEN'"}

{"sql":"SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.billed - CASE WHEN o.day >= '2025-07-01' THEN COALESCE(c.credits, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_net_collections FROM rowan_orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT oid, SUM(cents) AS credits FROM rowan_credit WHERE state = 'settled2' GROUP BY oid) c ON c.oid = o.oid WHERE o.state = 'ok1'"}
